name: Squadron
description: Spawns and runs its members (entries naming it with +0x11). With a door id it keeps those doors locked until every member is dead. MSR mod #6, 'Doors that open when a squadron is dead'. Other fields (baddy type, count, formation) are not decoded yet: copy them from a stock squadron.

fields.name: doorId
fields.description: doors with this id stay locked until the squadron is dead (whether 0 means none is not confirmed)

fields.name: region
fields.description: navigation region; the list must have RegionPoints for it
